# Sales Discount Approval Playbook

Sales representatives may offer discounts up to 10% on Pro plans without additional approval.
Discounts from 11% to 20% require approval from the Sales Manager. Discounts above 20% require
approval from both the Sales Manager and Finance before a quote is sent to the customer.

Enterprise agreements longer than one year must include an annual price-adjustment clause unless
the VP of Sales approves an exception. Free implementation services may not be used as an
unrecorded discount; their estimated value must be included in the deal record.

All approval evidence must be attached to the Jira deal ticket and referenced in the CRM
opportunity before the contract moves to the negotiation stage.
